cases.reviewerAnswer: General habits normally use the simple present. Estar + gerundio presents ongoing activity, including activity during a limited period. The simple present can also describe current actions.
cases.notes: The variant policy should require an unambiguous aspectual context before enforcing a single form; habitual wording alone does not necessarily provide one.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Identify current actions and routines from the meaning of the whole utterance.
cases.notes: The parenthetical tense examples are useful prototypes, provided they are not treated as an exclusive tense-to-meaning test.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Use the appropriate present form of estar followed by an invariant gerund. In the illustrated sentences, no precedes estar.
cases.notes: For clarity, scope.noteUk could specify unstressed object/reflexive pronouns instead of the unrestricted «Займенники».

cases.reviewerAnswer: «Ahora mismo» means right now or at this very moment.
«En este momento» means at this moment or now.
«Mamá» means mum; the corresponding Ukrainian direct address is «мамо».
cases.notes: The usage label describes the use introduced here; it need not imply that mamá occurs only in direct address.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Estar + gerundio expresses ongoing activity. The simple present commonly expresses general habits, but the progressive can also describe temporary routines or repeated ongoing situations.
cases.element: content.body.steps[id=s3].blocks[2].text: «А от про звичку estar + герундій не підходить.»; content.body.steps[id=s8].blocks[0].items[3]: «Про «зараз» часто підходять обидві форми; про звичку — лише простий теперішній.»
cases.defect: Both passages categorically exclude habitual uses of the progressive. Spanish permits repeated or habitual situations presented as ongoing, especially temporary routines, as in «Últimamente estoy trabajando los sábados».
cases.correction: Explain that the simple present is the usual unmarked choice for general habits, while estar + gerundio can highlight the temporary or ongoing character of repeated activity. Remove both categorical exclusions.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, discussion of estar + gerundio and habitual/iterative interpretations (from memory).
Course contract, rule 8; review duties concerning false rules and misleading simplifications.
cases.notes: The lesson's acknowledgment that both forms can describe current actions is correct.

cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «Los sábados ___ al fútbol con mis amigos.»; task.options[id=b].label: «estoy jugando» and feedbackUk: «Los sábados — регулярна дія, звичка: тут потрібен простий теперішній.»
cases.defect: Los sábados establishes recurrence but does not determine the aspectual perspective. The packet does not exclude a temporary recurring arrangement or a repeated ongoing situation, under which the progressive is possible.
cases.correction: Specify the intended aspectual reading, or accept both forms with explanations of their readings. Do not derive a unique simple-present answer from Los sábados alone.

cases.reviewerAnswer: a for a general statement about his usual employment; b is possible when describing his normally ongoing activity. The intended perspective is not fully fixed.
cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «Normalmente mi padre ___ en un banco, pero esta semana está de vacaciones.»; task.options[id=b].label: «está trabajando» and feedbackUk: «Normalmente — звичка: тут потрібен простий теперішній.»
cases.defect: Normalmente can modify an ongoing situation as well as an unmarked habitual present. The holiday contrast favors trabaja but does not make está trabajando categorically unacceptable.
cases.correction: Clarify that the task asks for the unmarked statement of his usual employment, or allow both readings and revise the feedback.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, habitual/iterative interpretations of estar + gerundio (from memory).

cases.reviewerAnswer: a directly describes Pablo's current activity. b can explain his whereabouts through his Sunday routine if today is Sunday.
cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «—¿Dónde está Pablo? —En el parque: …»; task.options[id=b].label: «juega con el perro los domingos.» and feedbackUk: «Los domingos — звичка, а питають, де Пабло зараз і що робить.»
cases.defect: The question asks where Pablo is, and En el parque already answers it. A habitual clause can then explain that location on a Sunday. The day is unspecified, and the question does not explicitly ask what he is doing.
cases.correction: Ask explicitly for Pablo's activity at the moment of speaking and state that the continuation must report that activity, or allow the explanatory routine reading.

cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «En mi casa ___ a las nueve todos los días.»; task.options[id=b].label: «estamos cenando» and feedbackUk: «Todos los días — звичка: тут потрібен простий теперішній.»
cases.defect: The combination of a reference time and daily recurrence permits the progressive: dinner can be underway at nine each day. The prompt does not specify whether nine is the usual meal time or a point during the meal.
cases.correction: Specify the intended temporal perspective, or accept both forms with feedback distinguishing the two readings.
